title: Remote is kinda useless
text: Remote is kinda useless. The remote only works if you point it directly at  the receiver at the end of the lights and the lights are on the back of the tv. To change the color or brightness I have to reach my arm around to the back of the tv. If my tv was wall mounted the remote would be all but useless.
